vt.

She looked at him, love and disgust mingled on her face.
她望着他，脸上露出爱与恨交织的表情。

The colours don't mingle well.
这些颜色不宜混合。

红色和蓝色被这个小孩混在了一起。

混合起来，相混合：
The various sounds mingled pleasantly.
各种不同的声音悦耳地交织在一起。

如果我们混在人群里，就不会被注意到了。

He used to train in a local park and mingle with other runners.
他过去常在地方公园里锻炼，并与其他跑步的人相交往。

We had about ten hours' warning, so we were able to minimize the effects of the flood.

It would be most unwise to minimize the dangers of this course of action.

He has muddled all the arrangements.

The more you talk, the more you muddle me.
你越说我越糊涂了。

A glass of whisky soon muddled her.

She muddled all the different kinds of books together on one shelf.

The bird muddled the brook with its splashings.

He always muddled with his homework.
他做作业总是敷衍了事。

He's still muddling on.
